title: Figure 10: Conventional MRAM cell vs STT MRAM cell schematic
description: Two color 3D device schematics captioned 'Figure 10. Conventional MRAM Cell (a) Versus STT MRAM Cell (b) (Reference 58)'. Panel (a) labels Bit line, MTJ, Bypass Line, Cladding, Landing Pad, Gate, Source, Drain, Si substrate and Write Word Line; panel (b) shows the simpler STT cell with Bit line, MTJ, Gate, Source, Drain and Si substrate.
